plan.output: A reviewable outreach queue with a tailored invitation draft and consent/status fields for each operator-supplied prospective merchant.
inputs: Fictional prospect record with a public opt-in contact route
App problem description supplied by the developer
Research purpose and proposed conversation length
plan.trigger: The app developer supplies an eligible prospect and requests a research invitation draft.
steps: Check that the prospect record includes an operator-verified public opt-in route.
Draft a short invitation from the supplied research purpose and approved wording.
Place the invitation and consent status in a review queue.
Have the developer verify relevance and approve any outreach.
Record replies and schedule only conversations the merchant accepts.
plan.acceptanceCheck: For synthetic prospect records, each draft must use only supplied facts, include the stated research purpose, and remain unsent until a person approves it; declined or unknown consent must not be queued for follow-up.
plan.humanBoundary: The developer must find prospects through appropriate channels, verify contact permissions, approve every message, and conduct the conversation; the proposal does not automate access to merchants or send outreach.
